days.title: Noah and the Rainbow
days.hook: The whole world laughed at him. Then the rain came.
days.story: God told Noah to build an ark long before there was a cloud in the sky. Noah obeyed, year after year. When the flood came, his family was kept safe inside. Afterward God set a rainbow in the clouds as a promise to never flood the earth again.
days.reflection: Obedience can look foolish right up until the day it saves you.
days.call_to_action: Type Amen if you're still building in faith 🙏

days.title: Abraham Believed
days.hook: He was 75 when God said, 'Go.' He went.
days.story: God called Abram to leave his country and his family for a land he had never seen. Years later, still childless, God took him outside and told him to count the stars, because his descendants would be just as many. Abram believed God, and it was counted to him as righteousness.
days.reflection: It is never too late for God to start something new in you.
days.call_to_action: Share this with someone waiting on a promise ❤️

days.title: The Lord Is My Shepherd
days.hook: Read this slowly. Let it settle.
days.reflection: You are not walking this alone. You are being led.
days.call_to_action: Type Amen if you need His peace today 🙏

days.title: Joseph Forgives
days.hook: His brothers sold him. Years later, he saved their lives.
days.story: Joseph's brothers sold him into slavery out of jealousy. He was falsely accused and thrown into prison, yet God raised him to rule Egypt. When famine drove his brothers to him for food, Joseph forgave them and told them God had turned their evil into good.
days.reflection: What was meant to break you, God can use to bless many.
days.call_to_action: Type 'He turns it for good' if you believe it 🙌
art_query: Joseph reveals himself to his brothers painting

days.title: The Burning Bush
days.hook: A bush that burned but never burned up.
days.story: Moses was tending sheep in the wilderness when he saw a bush on fire that was not consumed. As he came near, God called his name and told him to take off his sandals, for the ground was holy. God sent him to free His people, and told him His name: I AM.
days.reflection: God can meet you in the most ordinary day and change everything.
days.call_to_action: Who needs this reminder today? Tag them ❤️

days.title: Be Still
days.hook: Stop for ten seconds. Breathe.
days.reflection: You don't have to fix everything today. He is still God.
days.call_to_action: Type Amen if you needed this 🙏

days.title: Crossing the Red Sea
days.hook: The sea in front. The army behind. No way out.
days.story: Pharaoh's army chased the Israelites to the edge of the Red Sea. The people panicked, but Moses told them to stand still and see what God would do. God sent a strong east wind all night, the waters parted, and they walked through on dry ground.
days.reflection: When there is no way, God makes one.
days.call_to_action: Type 'He makes a way' 🙌
art_query: crossing of the Red Sea painting
Israelites crossing the Red Sea painting

days.title: Ruth's Loyalty
days.hook: She could have gone home. She chose to stay.
days.story: After her husband died, Ruth refused to leave her grieving mother-in-law, Naomi. She went with her to a strange land and gleaned leftover grain to feed them both. Boaz noticed her kindness and married her, and Ruth became the great-grandmother of King David.
days.reflection: Faithfulness in small, hidden places is never wasted.
days.call_to_action: Tag someone who has stayed with you ❤️

days.title: New Every Morning
days.hook: Yesterday is over. Look at this.
days.reflection: Whatever happened yesterday, this morning His mercy is brand new.
days.call_to_action: Type 'New mercies' 🙏

days.title: Hannah's Prayer
days.hook: She prayed so hard the priest thought she was drunk.
days.story: Hannah longed for a child for years and was mocked for it. At the temple she poured out her heart to God in silent tears. The priest Eli blessed her, and God answered. She named her son Samuel and gave him back to the Lord's service.
days.reflection: God hears the prayers you can't even say out loud.
days.call_to_action: What are you praying for? Drop a 🙏 and we'll pray with you
art_query: Hannah presenting Samuel to Eli painting

days.title: David and Goliath
days.hook: A shepherd boy. Five stones. One giant.
days.story: For forty days the giant Goliath mocked Israel's army, and every soldier was afraid. Young David, a shepherd, said the battle belonged to the Lord. He refused the king's armor, picked up five smooth stones, and brought the giant down with his sling.
days.reflection: Your giant is big. Your God is bigger.
days.call_to_action: Type 'The battle is the Lord's' ⚔️

days.title: Wings Like Eagles
days.hook: Running on empty? This is for you.
days.reflection: Waiting on God is where your strength comes back.
days.call_to_action: Share with someone who's tired ❤️

days.title: The Still Small Voice
days.hook: God wasn't in the earthquake. He was in the whisper.
days.story: After a great victory, the prophet Elijah ran for his life, exhausted and afraid. God let him sleep and sent food. On the mountain there was a mighty wind, an earthquake and a fire, but God was in none of them. Then came a still small voice.
days.reflection: Turn the noise down today. He is speaking gently.
days.call_to_action: Type Amen if you're listening 🙏
art_query: Elijah in the wilderness angel painting

days.title: Daniel in the Lions' Den
days.hook: He prayed anyway. Then they threw him to the lions.
days.story: Daniel kept praying to God even after it was made illegal. He was thrown into a den of lions and the stone was sealed. At dawn the king ran to the den and called out. Daniel answered. God had shut the lions' mouths, and not a scratch was found on him.
days.reflection: Faithfulness in private is what holds you up in public.
days.call_to_action: Type Amen if you're standing firm 🙏
art_query: Daniel in the Lions' Den Rubens
Daniel in the Lions' Den painting

days.title: Plans to Prosper
days.hook: Your story is not over.
days.reflection: God's thoughts toward you are peace, not harm.
days.call_to_action: Type 'I receive it' 🙌

days.title: The Fiery Furnace
days.hook: Bow or burn. They chose neither.
days.story: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego refused to bow to the king's golden statue. Furious, the king heated the furnace seven times hotter and had them thrown in. Then he saw four men walking unbound in the fire. They came out without even the smell of smoke.
days.reflection: You may not avoid the fire, but you won't be in it alone.
days.call_to_action: Tag someone going through the fire ❤️
art_query: Shadrach Meshach Abednego fiery furnace painting
three young men in the furnace painting

days.title: For Such a Time as This
days.hook: She risked her life to walk into one room.
days.story: A decree went out to destroy the Jewish people, and Queen Esther was one of them. Going to the king uninvited could mean death. After three days of fasting she went anyway, saying, 'If I perish, I perish.' The king spared her, and her people were saved.
days.reflection: You are where you are for a reason.
days.call_to_action: Type 'For such a time as this' 👑

days.title: Come Unto Me
days.hook: Tired in a way sleep can't fix?
days.reflection: Lay it down. You were never meant to carry it alone.
days.call_to_action: Type Amen and leave it with Him 🙏

days.title: Jonah and the Great Fish
days.hook: He ran from God. God sent a fish.
days.story: God told Jonah to warn the city of Nineveh, but Jonah boarded a ship going the other way. A storm hit, he was thrown overboard, and a great fish swallowed him. After three days of prayer in the belly of the fish, he was given a second chance, and this time he went.
days.reflection: Running from God never outruns His mercy.
days.call_to_action: Type 'Second chances' if you've had one 🙌

days.title: A Savior Is Born
days.hook: Shepherds on a night shift got the biggest news in history.
days.story: There was no room at the inn, so Mary laid her newborn son in a manger. That night an angel appeared to shepherds in the fields and told them not to be afraid. A Savior had been born. They hurried to Bethlehem and found Him, just as they had been told.
days.reflection: God came close, to ordinary people, in an ordinary place.
days.call_to_action: Share the good news ❤️

days.title: Be Strong and Courageous
days.hook: Wherever you're going today, read this first.
days.reflection: You are not walking into today alone.
days.call_to_action: Tag someone starting something new 💪

days.title: This Is My Beloved Son
days.hook: Before He did a single miracle, He heard this.
days.story: Jesus came to the Jordan River to be baptized by John. As He came up out of the water, the heavens opened and the Spirit of God descended like a dove. A voice from heaven said, 'This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.'
days.reflection: You are loved before you accomplish anything.
days.call_to_action: Type 'Beloved' if you needed this ❤️

days.title: Peace, Be Still
days.hook: The storm was real. So was the One in the boat.
days.story: The disciples were crossing the sea at night when a violent storm hit. Waves filled the boat while Jesus slept. Terrified, they woke Him. He stood up, spoke to the wind and the waves, 'Peace, be still,' and there was a great calm.
days.reflection: Whatever storm you're in, He has authority over it.
days.call_to_action: Type 'Peace, be still' 🌊
art_query: Christ in the Storm on the Sea of Galilee Rembrandt

days.title: I Will Lift Up Mine Eyes
days.hook: Look up for a second.
days.reflection: Your help is not coming from where you think. It's coming from Him.
days.call_to_action: Type Amen 🙏

days.title: Five Loaves, Two Fish
days.hook: A boy's lunch fed 5,000 people.
days.story: A huge crowd had followed Jesus and they were hungry. All anyone could find was a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish. Jesus gave thanks and broke them, and everyone ate until they were full. Twelve baskets of leftovers were gathered.
days.reflection: Give Him what little you have. Watch what He does with it.
days.call_to_action: Tag someone who gives generously ❤️
art_query: feeding of the five thousand painting
miracle of the loaves and fishes painting

days.title: Walking on Water
days.hook: He walked on water until he looked at the waves.
days.story: In the middle of the night Jesus came walking toward the disciples' boat on the sea. Peter asked to come to Him, and Jesus said, 'Come.' Peter stepped out and walked on the water, but when he saw the wind he began to sink. Jesus immediately reached out and caught him.
days.reflection: Even when your faith slips, His hand doesn't.
days.call_to_action: Type 'Eyes on Jesus' 👀🙏
art_query: Christ walking on the water painting

days.title: Peace I Leave With You
days.hook: Read this before the worry wins.
days.reflection: His peace doesn't depend on your circumstances.
days.call_to_action: Type Amen if you're receiving His peace 🙏

days.title: The Prodigal Son
days.hook: He wasted everything. His father ran to him anyway.
days.story: A young man demanded his inheritance and wasted it all. Broke and feeding pigs, he decided to go home and beg to be a servant. But while he was still far off, his father saw him, ran to him, embraced him and kissed him, and threw a feast.
days.reflection: It's never too late to come home. He's already running toward you.
days.call_to_action: Share this with someone who needs to come home ❤️
art_query: Return of the Prodigal Son Rembrandt
return of the prodigal son painting

days.title: The Good Samaritan
days.hook: Two religious men walked past. A stranger stopped.
days.story: A man was beaten, robbed and left half dead by the road. A priest passed by on the other side, then a Levite. But a Samaritan, a stranger from a despised people, stopped, bandaged his wounds, carried him to an inn and paid for his care. Jesus said, 'Go, and do thou likewise.'
days.reflection: Love isn't about who someone is. It's about who you choose to be.
days.call_to_action: Tag someone who always stops to help ❤️

days.title: Joy Comes in the Morning
days.hook: If last night was hard, read this.
days.reflection: Tears last for a night. They do not get the last word.
days.call_to_action: Type 'Joy is coming' ☀️

days.title: The Lost Sheep
days.hook: He left 99 to find one.
days.story: Jesus told of a shepherd with a hundred sheep who lost one. He left the ninety-nine and searched until he found it. Then he carried it home on his shoulders, rejoicing, and called his friends to celebrate. Heaven rejoices like that over one person who turns back to God.
days.reflection: You are the one He would go looking for.
days.call_to_action: Type 'He found me' 🙌

days.title: Zacchaeus
days.hook: Everyone hated him. Jesus invited Himself to dinner.
days.story: Zacchaeus was a rich tax collector, short in height and despised by the town. He climbed a sycamore tree just to see Jesus pass. Jesus stopped, looked up, called him by name and said He was coming to his house. That day Zacchaeus' life was changed.
days.reflection: Jesus sees you, even when you're hiding in the branches.
days.call_to_action: Type 'He sees me' ❤️

days.title: I Can Do All Things
days.hook: Say it out loud today.
days.reflection: Not by your strength. By His.
days.call_to_action: Type 'Through Christ' 💪

days.title: The Woman at the Well
days.hook: She went to the well at noon to avoid people. She met Jesus.
days.story: A Samaritan woman came to draw water at the hottest hour of the day, alone. Jesus asked her for a drink and then told her everything she had ever done, without shame. He offered her living water. She ran back to town telling everyone to come and see.
days.reflection: Jesus knows your whole story and still offers you life.
days.call_to_action: Share this with someone who feels unseen ❤️
art_query: Christ and the Samaritan woman at the well painting

days.title: Lazarus, Come Forth
days.hook: Four days dead. Then Jesus said his name.
days.story: Lazarus had been in the tomb four days when Jesus arrived. His sisters wept, and Jesus wept with them. Then He had the stone rolled away and called out, 'Lazarus, come forth.' And the man who had died walked out of the tomb.
days.reflection: Nothing is too far gone for Him. Not even this.
days.call_to_action: Type 'He is the resurrection' 🙌

days.title: Fear Thou Not
days.hook: If you're afraid today, this is for you.
days.reflection: He doesn't just tell you not to fear. He tells you why: He is with you.
days.call_to_action: Tag someone who needs courage today ❤️

days.title: Blind Bartimaeus
days.hook: They told him to be quiet. He shouted louder.
days.story: Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, heard that Jesus was passing by and cried out for mercy. The crowd told him to hush, but he cried out even more. Jesus stopped and called him over. 'What do you want me to do for you?' Bartimaeus asked to see, and immediately he could.
days.reflection: Don't let anyone quiet your cry for help.
days.call_to_action: Type what you're asking Him for 🙏

days.title: Love One Another
days.hook: The King of kings knelt to wash feet.
days.story: On His last night with His disciples, Jesus took a towel and a basin and washed their dusty feet, the job of a servant. Peter protested, but Jesus insisted. Then He gave them a new commandment: love one another, as I have loved you.
days.reflection: Greatness in God's kingdom looks like serving.
days.call_to_action: Tag someone who serves without being asked ❤️
art_query: Christ washing the feet of the disciples painting

days.title: Trust in the Lord
days.hook: You don't have to figure it all out.
days.reflection: Trust Him with the next step. He sees the whole road.
days.call_to_action: Type Amen if you're trusting Him today 🙏

days.title: Father, Forgive Them
days.hook: His first words from the cross were for His enemies.
days.story: Jesus was mocked, beaten and nailed to a cross between two criminals. While the soldiers gambled for His clothes and the crowd jeered, He prayed for the very people hurting Him. 'Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do.'
days.reflection: If He forgave that, there is nothing you've done He won't forgive.
days.call_to_action: Type 'Forgiven' 🙏

days.title: He Is Risen
days.hook: They came to anoint a body. The tomb was empty.
days.story: Early on the first day of the week, the women came to the tomb with spices. The stone had been rolled away, and an angel sat on it. 'Fear not,' he said. 'He is not here: for he is risen, as he said.' They ran with fear and great joy to tell the disciples.
days.reflection: Because He lives, your hardest day is not your final day.
days.call_to_action: Type 'He is risen!' 🙌
art_query: three Marys at the tomb painting
angel at the empty tomb painting

days.title: This Is the Day
days.hook: Good morning. Start with this.
days.reflection: Find one reason to rejoice today. He made this day.
days.call_to_action: Type one thing you're thankful for ☀️

days.title: The Road to Emmaus
days.hook: They walked seven miles with Jesus and didn't recognize Him.
days.story: Two heartbroken disciples were walking home after the crucifixion. A stranger joined them and explained the scriptures about the Messiah. At dinner He broke the bread, and suddenly they recognized Jesus, and He vanished. 'Did not our heart burn within us?'
days.reflection: He is often walking with you before you realize it.
days.call_to_action: Share this with someone walking through grief ❤️

days.title: Singing at Midnight
days.hook: Beaten, chained, in prison. So they started singing.
days.story: Paul and Silas were beaten and locked in the inner prison with their feet in stocks. At midnight they prayed and sang hymns to God while the other prisoners listened. Suddenly an earthquake shook the prison, the doors flew open and every chain fell off.
days.reflection: Praise in the dark is powerful.
days.call_to_action: Type your favorite worship song 🎶
art_query: Paul and Silas in prison painting

days.title: The God of Hope
days.hook: A blessing for you tonight.
days.reflection: May you be so full of hope it overflows into everyone around you.
days.call_to_action: Type Amen and receive it 🙏
